intro.text: You're looking for a way to make some extra cash.
Luckily, you find a job: clearing leaves from people's gardens.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Nothing for you to do here right now.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Check back once you've got more experience around town.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: As I said, my name is Gilbert. I've lived here for as long as I can remember. I love this little village, even if most of my family lives pretty far away.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: My daughter and son used to drop by from time to time, but... well, they haven't been around much lately...

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: My name's Jane, cowboy! I'm a farmer. Moved to this town a few years back, looking for a quiet life, just me and my animals. Couldn't have picked a better place!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Most folks around here are real nice, too. Well... except for the butcher. Let's just say he's a little... strange. But hey, who am I to judge? We've all got our own problems, right?

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: I'm not your buddy, kid. I'm your customer. I'm not here to make small talk.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Hey kid, sorry... I don't trust you enough to let you in my garden....

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Who are you? Leave me alone kid i'm working...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Whoa there, kid. I got land that needs clearin', but you ain't ready for that mess yet.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Help Jane and that butcher with their gardens first. Then come find me.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Hey, kid! My name's Gilbert.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I heard you volunteered to clear all those damn leaves from our gardens this October. Well, ain't that just wonderful!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I've been looking for someone to take that chore off my hands.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: So, what do you say? Ready to get started? I can show you the garden.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Alright! Here's a broom... Sorry, it's all I've got!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Start by sweeping up the leaves out front, then dump 'em in the forest... Just make sure you don't toss 'em over the fences on either side. We don't want those leaves ending up in the neighbors' gardens!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Let's just hope they stay in the forest...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Well, look at you! You've got a knack for this, kid! Keep this up and I'll have to recommend you to a few of my friends, haha!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Say, you still looking for work? I know a farmer who could use a hand. Her garden's an absolute mess! You'll find her right in the middle of the village. Can't miss her — she's the one wearing the straw hat.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Go on, see what she's got for you!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Well, hello there, young man! You're the one who helped old Gilbert with his garden, aren't you? He said you did a wonderful job!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Say, would you be willing to give me a hand with mine? Between the farm work and everything else, I can barely keep up with the garden!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: How about it? Come on, I'll show you what needs doing!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Alright, here's my little patch of paradise! Now, what on earth are you gonna do with that broom?

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Here, take this rake, kid. Much more useful, trust me!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: You know the drill, right? Get these leaves outta my garden and dump 'em in the forest!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Well, I'll be darned! You're a natural, kid! You're really good at this. You oughta start your own business!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Not sure if you're done for the day, but that butcher I told you about earlier could use a hand... If you need the money, go on ahead. Just be careful, though. That guy's a little... off.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Alright! See ya around, partner!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Hey again, partner! Garden's still spotless thanks to you.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I don't have more work for you here. If you're still lookin' to earn a few bucks, try the butcher down the way.

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Well, aren't you the kid going around cleaning gardens for cheap? If you're looking for work, I could use a hand.

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Alright. Clean up the whole garden. I'm not here to teach you how to do your job. Take this vacuum. You ain't gonna finish before dark with a rake. Suck up the leaves and dump 'em in the forest. I'm not your damn boss. I shouldn't have to explain how to do your job, should I?

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: You done? About time. You should get going. Old Gilbert wanted to talk to you, I think. Now get lost...

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: I told you to get lost already. Gilbert's the one with more work for you not me.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Hey, kid! How'd Jane's garden turn out? Give you much trouble? Haha! Of course not, you're a pro at this by now!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Listen, I've got another job for you. Don't worry, it's not my garden again! Haha, I haven't messed it up... yet.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I've got some land just outside the village that I haven't touched in years. Place is a real mess, to say the least.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: So, what do you say? I'll pay you a little extra this time!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Alright, here we are! That rake Jane gave you is great and all, but I bought you a little something to help out... How about a brand-new leaf blower?!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: With this baby, you can blow those leaves right outta the garden in no time! Go on, have some fun... and help me out while you're at it, hehe!

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Hey... you... Don't be afraid... I'm nice... I've been watching you from the very beginning, and... you found some things in that butcher's garden, didn't you? Please... show them to me.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: These are perfect! They could prove that damn butcher murdered me... and finally set my soul free, so I can move on to the afterlife!

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Please... if you really wanna help me, take them to the police. Tell them what that monster did!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Hey, kid! What are you doin'—?

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Wait... What in the world?!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Is that... a ghost?!

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Grandpa...? You can see me...?

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Thomas...? Is that really you...?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Grandpa! You can finally see me!

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: It must be because... because this kid found the evidence! The proof that the butcher... that he murdered me!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: The butcher...? It was HIM all along?!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: But... everyone thought I did it! They all blamed me... Nobody wanted anything to do with me anymore. I lost everything, Thomas... Everything...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: And all this time... it was that bastard?!

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I... I can't believe it...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Thomas...? What's happening to you, son?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: My murder... it's been solved.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: I can feel it... I'm finally free, Grandpa. I can leave this world behind... and go to heaven.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: No... No, wait... Not yet...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Thomas, my little boy...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I've missed you so much. I've prayed for you every single night, hopin' that one day, somehow, I'd find out what happened to you...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: And now... now that I can finally see you again...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: But... if it's time for you to go, then go, my boy. You've been here long enough.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: You deserve to rest. You deserve some peace.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I'll make sure that butcher pays for what he did to you. I promise. I'll see that justice is done, Thomas. You have my word.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: And you, kid...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I don't even know what to say. Thank you. Truly.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: You found the truth when everyone else had given up. You cleared my name... and you helped my grandson find peace.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: For years, I thought I'd lost everything. I thought the whole village would always see me as a monster...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: But you've given me my life back, kid.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I can never thank you enough.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Grandpa...

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Thank you for never forgetting me.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: Goodbye...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I love you too, Thomas...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: I always will.

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Rest easy now, my boy...

lines.speaker: gilbert
lines.text: Rest easy...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And it was where they shared their happiest moments, that they were both set free in their own way..
